threshold.BUYABLE: statistically robust advantage (median ≥20% improvement across parameter space) + preserved drainage in ≥95% of trials + 102 SURVIVES + defensible IP + realistic prototype path
threshold.MILESTONE_WORTHY: median ≥10% improvement + preserved drainage + defined experiment to confirm
threshold.TRUE_CEILING: median <10% improvement OR drainage not preserved in >5% of trials
threshold.PRIOR_ART_WALL: meaningful implementations blocked by existing claims

rationale: 20% is the minimum clinically detectable improvement in a small trial. 95% drainage preservation is the safety floor.
